message: 論
Day one of midterms is over.
On my way home, I take a detour and head over to the shopping district.
I've heard that light exercise gets the brain moving better. To make it through day two of exams tomorrow without a hitch, I figure I'll walk around a bit more.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Isn't that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright! Let's get today's Sweets Club meeting started!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whee-whee! Bravo, bravooo!」

name: Yumil
message: 「...Um, I kinda wanted to go home and study for the exams, though. Aren't all the other clubs and societies taking a break right now to prep for tests?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's the exact reason why, Ymirrr.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! If we hold activities and get results right now, we'll totally get the jump on the Wagashi Club!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Y-You don't really have to go that far, do you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka? You're really going ahead with a sweets crawl right in the middle of midterms?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ohhh? You came to join in too, Synn-kun? You're super welcome!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, I'm just passing by.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, it's precisely because we're in the middle of exams that we're betting our grades on sweets!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I have no idea what you're even talking about...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, when you're studying, your brain gets tired and you start craving something sweet, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, replenishing your sugar is essential for mental labor.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There you go! If we stuff ourselves full of sweets first and then hit the desk, our study efficiency is guaranteed to shoot up!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's right, that's right! You're so sharp, Nana-channn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that really how it works...?」

name: Yumil
message: 「At the very least, I don't think she's wrong... However...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're so stubborn, Ymirrr. Still not convinced? Then as vice president, I'll back her up!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You know that famous story, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「The boy who honestly confessed and apologized after snapping a cherry blossom branch grew up to become president!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Therefore, if any random guy around here snaps a cherry blossom branch, he'll become the prime minister!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Just like Nana-chan--thinking outside the box, aren't you~」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it」

name: Yumil
message: 「Not at all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin! I was just about to win Yumil over……!」

name: Yumil
message: 「W-Win me over?! What's that supposed to mean, Yuugiri-senpai!? I think I'll really take my leave for today」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, me too――」

name: Sacchin
message: 「O-hohohoho~ Sweets Club Blood Oath Number One~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「『Those who come shall not leave~ Those who pursue shall not be refused~』」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yumil~, Secret Technique: Jizo Hold~, glomp~♪」

name: Yumil
message: 「Gwah…… I-I can't move」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Come on, Nana-chan, you catch Synn-kun too~! Rub-rub-rub~~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Sacchin-senpai, please let go. I don't swing that way!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urk…… You want me to put that move on Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I mean, that's a little too much……」

name: Synn
message: 「See you later, Nanaka. Let's both do our best on the exams」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, you bet! B-Bye-bye, Synn」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh dear~, Nana-chan~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Laugh if you want!! Go ahead and laugh at this coward」
After parting ways with the Sweets Club, I continued my walk for a while.
